source_snapshot.test_name_items: Check switch function about BIOS Password clear.
source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Check switch function about BIOS Password clear.
1.Make Switch to another side.
2. Power on system , negative to jumper function page check.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Switch to another side , systerm still can power onsuccessfully.
2. Switch need functionaly.
3. Switch to orginal side , system should not hang or create error log.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- not runnable by agent: this switch-function check for BIOS Password clear (via the BIOS-Password-clear path) requires physically moving the BIOS-Password-clear jumper to the other side, powering on to the jumper-function page in BIOS to confirm the feature engages, then returning the switch and confirming the system powers on with no hang/error. Toggling the onboard jumper and reading the BIOS BIOS-Password-clear path page is physical/Pre-OS work only a person at the machine can do.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: operator toggles the BIOS-Password-clear jumper (BIOS-Password-clear path), powers on, reads the BIOS jumper page, restores the switch, and confirms a clean power-on with no error log; agent cannot operate the motherboard jumper.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: physical/hardware operation at the machine - human only; agent must not attempt.

historical_reviews.deepseek: NO. Correctly preserves alternate/original physical action and Pre-OS observation.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY / IMPROVED. V2 adds exact switch identity, credential/security backup, ambiguity resolution and restoration proof.

original_test_intent: Verify the physical BIOS-password-clear switch path enters its expected firmware function while alternate, then returns to normal boot with no hang or new errors after restoration.
original_method: A qualified operator backs up credential/boot state, de-energizes the board, records and moves the identified switch, powers on and observes the specified BIOS page/behavior, powers down, restores the original side, reboots and verifies security and health.
manual_activity: Physical switch movement/restoration and direct Pre-OS BIOS screen/password behavior are core acceptance steps that an agent cannot perform or prove remotely.
required_inputs: Exact board and BIOS-password-clear switch reference/map
Original/alternate orientation and authoritative function-page expectation
Expected password, secure-boot, key and setting impact with backups
De-energization/ESD procedure, boot timeout and recovery
Final state, operator and one-user approval
safety_requirements: Never move the switch while powered and never act on an uncertain component.
Protect BIOS credentials, boot keys and security/configuration backups.
Stop on no boot, unexpected credential clearing, firmware/security change, hang or OOB loss.
Restore and visually verify the original side before final boot; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Collect read-only board/BIOS identity, BMC/SEL/console and post-boot health evidence.
Correlate operator position records with firmware page and security-state comparison.
Do not move the switch, expose secrets or set the verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve switch map, function and credential recovery.
Perform all physical moves and BIOS observations.
Verify restored security/boot state and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The no-command human-only boundary is appropriate and retains restoration, but platform/security details remain required.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain the source physical/Pre-OS sequence with read-only supporting logs only.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Alternate side, BIOS function check, original-side restoration, no-hang/no-error and 10/20-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.status: RETAIN PHYSICAL PASSWORD-CLEAR SWITCH TEST WITH SECURITY BASELINE
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use board-specific position photos, console capture and before/after password/secure-boot/boot-setting checks, with explicit restoration and credential-safe evidence.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact motherboard, BIOS and password-clear switch implementation.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Owner board switch and BIOS password-clear/security specification.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds security-state backup and auditable restoration without replacing the switch.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No loss; the physical path and firmware response remain required.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Switch mapping, function semantics, backups and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Screenshots must not expose passwords or keys, and a generic BIOS status cannot prove switch actuation.

project_override_considerations: A project must define which password class and security state the switch is expected to affect. It may mask secrets in evidence but cannot replace the physical switch path with a software password-clear action.
expected_evidence: Board/BIOS/switch map, function/security expectations, backups and authorization
Original and alternate position records with power timestamps
BIOS function-page/password/security behavior and console/BMC/SEL evidence
Original-side restoration, normal boot/no errors, approved security state and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The phrase `negative to jumper function page check` is ambiguous wording, but title, DeepSeek context and criteria consistently indicate inspecting the alternate switch function before restoration.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The exact page and security impact are owner readiness inputs; a qualified operator can execute the defined physical sequence once supplied.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Agree with NO and preserve its restoration path.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agree with MANUAL ONLY and credential/security safeguards.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates manual evidence, agent-collected telemetry and engineer verdict.

review_improvement: Makes the security impact and original-position recovery auditable instead of treating any BIOS page as sufficient proof.
independent_technical_reasoning: The tested path depends on a motherboard switch and Pre-OS behavior with possible credential changes. These are human physical/visual core steps, so software evidence can only corroborate a MANUAL ONLY test.
